);

);

    SectionNo INT,
    PRIMARY KEY (CourseNo, SectionNo),

        ON UPDATE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE ENROLLS (

    CourseNo INT,
    SectionNo INT,
    PRIMARY KEY (SSN, CourseNo, SectionNo),
    FOREIGN KEY (SSN) REFERENCES STUDENT(SSN)
        ON DELETE CASCADE
        ON UPDATE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (CourseNo, SectionNo) REFERENCES SECTION(CourseNo, SectionNo)
        ON DELETE CASCADE
        ON UPDATE CASCADE
);

    CourseNo INT,
    SectionNo INT,
    ExamNo INT,
    PRIMARY KEY (CourseNo, SectionNo, ExamNo),
    FOREIGN KEY (CourseNo, SectionNo) REFERENCES SECTION(CourseNo, SectionNo)

SELECT SSN, First_Name, Last_Name
FROM STUDENT
WHERE SSN IN (
    SELECT SSN
    FROM ENROLLS
    WHERE CourseNo = (SELECT CourseNo FROM COURSE WHERE Course_Name = 'Computer Architecture')
);

SELECT S.SSN, S.First_Name, S.Last_Name, E.CourseNo, E.SectionNo
FROM STUDENT S
JOIN ENROLLS E ON S.SSN = E.SSN
WHERE E.CourseNo = (SELECT CourseNo FROM COURSE WHERE Course_Name = 'VLSI');

SELECT C.Course_Name, C.CourseNo
FROM COURSE C
JOIN ENROLLS E ON C.CourseNo = E.CourseNo
GROUP BY C.Course_Name, C.CourseNo
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT E.SSN) >= 2;

SELECT S.SSN, S.First_Name, S.Last_Name
FROM STUDENT S
JOIN TAKES T ON S.SSN = T.SSN
WHERE T.Result >= 90
GROUP BY S.SSN, S.First_Name, S.Last_Name
HAVING COUNT(T.ExamNo) >= 2;

SELECT C.CourseNo, C.SectionNo, C.ExamNo, CR.RoomNo, CR.Building, CR.Capacity
FROM CONDUCTED_IN C
JOIN CLASS_ROOM CR ON C.RoomNo = CR.RoomNo AND C.Building = CR.Building
WHERE CR.Building = 'Riverside Hall';

SELECT S.SSN, S.First_Name, S.Last_Name
FROM STUDENT S
JOIN ENROLLS E ON S.SSN = E.SSN
WHERE E.CourseNo IN (
    SELECT CourseNo
    FROM COURSE
    WHERE Course_Name IN ('Programming I', 'Programming II')
);

SELECT C.Course_Name, COUNT(S.SectionNo) AS Num_Sections
FROM COURSE C
JOIN SECTION S ON C.CourseNo = S.CourseNo
GROUP BY C.Course_Name
HAVING COUNT(S.SectionNo) > 2;

SELECT CR.Building, CR.RoomNo, CR.Capacity, C.CourseNo, C.SectionNo, C.ExamNo
FROM CLASS_ROOM CR
LEFT JOIN CONDUCTED_IN C ON CR.RoomNo = C.RoomNo AND CR.Building = C.Building
WHERE CR.Building = 'RVR';
